figures.finding: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands, a UK Overseas Territory, has no permanent residents (only government officers and British Antarctic Survey staff), so it has no actors, no union and no agreement; a professional film crew comes as a media visit arranged with the territory's government, by sea and subject to the Entry Control Ordinance 2022.

value.filming: professional media visit arranged with GSGSSI (admin@gov.gs); entry under the Entry Control Ordinance 2022

figures.applies: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands, 2026.

sources.said: There are no permanent residents in the Territory but the British Antarctic Survey (BAS) operates two bases on South Georgia.
There is no permanent human population on South Georgia.
All visitors are subject to the Entry Control Ordinance 2022.
If you are planning a professional media visit to the Territory, please contact us at admin@gov.gs .
